Modern musical works from Stravinsky's Rite of Spring onward still send ripples of unease through audiences. Yet the influence of modern music can be felt everywhere. Avant-garde sounds populate the soundtracks of Hollywood thrillers. Minimalist music has had a huge effect on rock, pop, and dance music. Music critic Alex Ross shines a bright light on this world and the end result is not so much a history of twentieth-century music as a history of the twentieth century through its music.--From publisher description
